semiconductor_relevance: High — Asahi Diamond Industrial GmbH manufactures precision tools essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Asahi Diamond Industrial GmbH specializes in designing and manufacturing diamond and cubic boron nitride (CBN) tools used in various production processes, including cutting, grinding, and polishing, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing. With over 2,000 employees and a global presence, the company supports the semiconductor industry with high-performance equipment tailored for precision applications.
capabilities: Diamond and CBN cutting tools for semiconductor applications
Grinding and polishing equipment for wafer processing

regional_presence.Europe: Asahi Diamond Industrial GmbH has a manufacturing and sales network across twelve countries in Europe.
